product.name: Managed Delivery Service
product.description: A service that manages email outreach deliverability for sales teams, ensuring emails land in recipients' primary inboxes rather than spam folders.

product.name: Email Delivery Network
product.description: A proprietary email delivery infrastructure that routes sales outreach emails through Lightmeter's own servers, separate from common providers like Google or Microsoft.

product.name: Analytics Platform
product.description: A platform providing comprehensive tracking and reporting of email delivery performance, including inbox placement, open rates, and trends.

product.name: Warmup Warrantee
product.description: A service that establishes and maintains domain reputation through a controlled warmup process powered by generative AI.

product.name: Disruption Prevention
product.description: A feature that prepares backup domains and mailboxes, warmed and ready to replace primary sending domains seamlessly if needed.

product.name: Address Validation
product.description: An automated process that verifies email addresses before sending to reduce bounces and improve deliverability metrics.
